description.value: Crust N Crunch is a pizza and donair counter located inside SFU's Academic Quadrangle building (Level 3000) on Burnaby Mountain campus, part of a small Metro Vancouver chain. The menu features pizza by the slice, whole pies, and donair — all prepared with halal ingredients and a wide range of vegetarian options. It is a convenient calorie stop for cyclists climbing Burnaby Mountain or passing through the SFU campus.

address.value: 8888 University Dr W, Burnaby, BC V5A 1S6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is the SFU Burnaby Campus location of Crust N Crunch, at 8888 University Dr W in the AQ Building Level 3000, with phone (778) 782-8310 matching OSM. OSM tag 'takeaway: only' is consistent with the campus food-counter context; the menu page lists numerous vegetarian pizzas marked with a 🌿 icon, confirming vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags.
